physical_subject: Why does the median minimize equal-cost absolute prediction error?
relationship: For a finite ordered odd-size sample, outside-pair distance bounds plus the unpaired middle observation prove that the median minimizes the sum of absolute errors.
operation: Compare three guesses, then pair ordered observations to prove a lower bound attained at the middle value.
